answer: Proposal: keys register freely, but weight is max-flow from a fixed root set over an endorsement graph: incumbents issue at most two bonded endorsements — violet marks — per epoch, each a unit-capacity edge; the bond is slashed when an endorsed key provably double-signs. A thousand keys spawned by dawn change nothing: flow reaches the clone trellis only through its few earned edges, so influence costs real endorsements from scarce, risk-bearing elders — linear in bought elders, deterring only while it exceeds capped rewards. Root capture and bribery remain open.
